mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place_details ( place_id, overview, tel, homepage_url, opening_hours, closed_days, admission_fee, parking_info, pet_allowed, reservation_required, `setting`, intro_json, fetched_at ) VALUES ( #{placeId}, #{overview,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{tel,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{homepageUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{openingHours,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{closedDays,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{admissionFee,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{parkingInfo,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{petAllowed,jdbcType=BOOLEAN}, #{reservationRequired,jdbcType=BOOLEAN}, COALESCE(#{setting,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'UNKNOWN'), #{introJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fetchedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )
mapper.select: SELECT place_id, overview, tel, homepage_url, opening_hours, closed_days, admission_fee, parking_info, pet_allowed, reservation_required, `setting`, intro_json, fetched_at FROM place_details WHERE place_id = #{placeId}
